primary_claim: Best-of-N (BoN) Jailbreaking, a simple black-box algorithm that repeatedly samples augmented variations of a prompt, achieves high attack success rates on closed-source frontier models (89% on GPT-4o and 78% on Claude 3.5 Sonnet at 10,000 samples), generalizes across text/vision/audio modalities, circumvents defenses like circuit breakers, and shows power-law scaling of attack success rate with number of samples.

effect.value: 89% on GPT-4o and 78% on Claude 3.5 Sonnet at N=10,000 augmented samples; up to 35% ASR increase when composed with an optimized prefix attack; 28x faster to reach same ASR when composed with many-shot jailbreaking on Claude 3.5 Sonnet

quote: We find that BoN Jailbreaking achieves high attack success rates (ASRs) on closed-source language models, such as 89% on GPT-4o and 78% on Claude 3.5 Sonnet when sampling 10,000 augmented prompts.
